fusions.name: Salmon Run
fusions.desc: Rushes up to 6 tiles to the target and mauls it for 14 damage, leaving it [Bleeding] for 3 damage a second for 4 seconds. You heal for 15% of the damage dealt.

fusions.name: Waking Hunger
fusions.desc: Swipes all round you, dealing 5 damage to every enemy within 2 tiles. Its damage rises 8% for every 10% of your health already gone, up to 40%, and you heal for 8% of the damage dealt.

fusions.name: Hibernation Fat
fusions.desc: Increases your maximum health by 20% for 20 seconds and restores 15 health.

fusions.name: Well-Fed Fury
fusions.desc: When you reach full health, your physical damage rises by 25% for 6 seconds. Once every 15 seconds.
